  "jobspec": "#!/usr/bin/env sh

# Flux batch script (translated from Slurm)

# Slurm requested:
#   --job-name=rate_shift_type
#   --mail-type=END,FAIL

#   --mem-per-cpu=4GB

#   --error=logs/rate_shift_type.err
#   --qos=low_prio_res
#   --ntasks=1
#   --nodes=1
#   --cpus-per-task=100
#   --partition=krypton

flux alloc \
  -N 1 \
  -n 1 \
  -c 100 \
  --queue=krypton \
  bash -lc '

mkdir -p logs

# Approximate Slurm --output/--error via redirection.
exec >logs/rate_shift_type.log 2>logs/rate_shift_type.err

# NOTE: Slurm email notifications (--mail-user/--mail-type) have no universally portable Flux batch directive.
# Performance implication: none for runtime, but you will not receive END/FAIL emails.

# NOTE: Slurm --job-name is not expressed here as a portable Flux batch directive.

julia --threads 100 scripts/06_rate_shift_type_inference.jl > logs/rate_shift_type_inference.txt
'
"
}
